reviews.text: Amazing. I’m in love with the beautifully crafted collar and lead I bought from Madreperla. The quality is superb and I highly recommend their products. Fast delivery and excellent customer service. Love love love 🐶🐶🐶♥️♥️♥️ …

If you're looking for a run-of-the-mill pet store, Madreperla Boutique isn't for you. Madreperla is a true atelier of high fashion and wellness, dedicated exclusively to our four-legged friends. From the first click, you'll sense a refined atmosphere, meticulously crafted down to the smallest details, designed for those who want only the best for their dog! Highly recommended!

I ordered this super hands-free leash set from her because I've been in love with it for a while now... seeing that they were selling out, I got ready to buy it... Carola was very quick with everything... very sweet in everything... and the set is amazing... besides being aesthetically wonderful, it's really very comfortable! I highly recommend it... she already knows I'm eyeing something else 🥹😍😍😍

I ordered two matching harness and leash sets from Madreperla Milano Pets Boutique for my Chihuahua.
Before ordering, I immediately contacted Carola to ask if she had a very small size for my Chihuahua, as it's hard to find, and she has them!
The sets, besides being beautiful, are comfortable and smell like leather. Carola is very kind; she responds promptly to any problems or questions. Recommended for anyone with a mini Chihuahua like me.

I bought the harness for my dachshund a few weeks ago. Let's start by saying that the packaging is beautiful, different from other brands as it's not a miserable cardboard box. The material of the harness isn't the usual Chinese plastic we're used to, but everything is handmade in Milan, Italy, which is why I chose them. Now I've seen that you can also customize the collars 🤩🤩🤩🤩, so I'll definitely buy another one. Until the next purchase! Highly recommended.
